title: EBOOK HAIR LOSS

Objective: Deliver a comprehensive, science-backed, actionable guide that helps readers restore scalp health, reduce hair loss, and optimize hair growth naturally and effectively. Tone and Style: - Professional yet easy to understand - Authoritative and trustworthy - Motivational without exaggeration - Clean, modern, and premium - Written like a high-ticket digital product Length: 25-35 pages. Introduction - My personal struggle with hair loss and scalp issues - Why most hair loss advice fails - The importance of scalp health 3. Understanding Hair Loss - Main causes of hair loss - DHT explained simply - Stress and cortisol - Nutritional deficiencies - Inflammation and scalp health 4. Understanding Seborrheic Dermatitis - Causes - Symptoms - Common triggers - Why most treatments fail 5. The Complete Daily Hair Routine - Morning routine - Evening routine - Weekly routine 6. My Scalp Massage Method - Step-by-step instructions - Duration - Technique - Common mistakes - Expected results 7. Hair Washing Protocol - How often to wash - Water temperature - Shampoo selection - Conditioner usage 8. Best Ingredients for Hair Growth - Minoxidil - Ketoconazole - Caffeine - Rosemary oil - Peptides - Biotin 9. Seborrheic Dermatitis Recovery Protocol - 4-week healing plan - Anti-inflammatory approach - Product recommendations - Maintenance strategy 10. Nutrition for Hair Growth - Essential vitamins and minerals - Best foods - Foods to avoid 11. Supplements That Actually Work - Evidence-based supplements only - Dosages - Timing 12. Lifestyle Optimization - Sleep - Exercise - Stress management - Sun exposure 13. Common Hair Loss Myths Debunked - At least 10 myths 14. Frequently Asked Questions 15. Final Action Plan - 30-day implementation roadmap Requirements: - Include practical step-by-step instructions. - Use bullet points, checklists, and summaries. - Base recommendations on scientific evidence. - Avoid unrealistic promises. - Include disclaimers where necessary. - Make it visually structured and easy to read. - Add premium formatting suggestions for Canva design. - Ensure the content is unique, engaging, and valuable enough to sell for $69-$99. Output format: Provide the full eBook content in well-structured Markdown, ready for PDF or Canva design.
